entities.name: A1BEM6 QueA
observations: Exact sequence match to reviewed UniProt A1BEM6 (Chlorobium phaeobacteroides); annotated as S-adenosylmethionine:tRNA ribosyltransferase-isomerase, EC 2.4.99.17.
Catalyzes transfer and isomerization of the ribose moiety from S-adenosyl-L-methionine to tRNA-bound preQ1, producing epoxyqueuosine-modified tRNA.

entities.name: QueA preQ1 to oQ
observations: Rhea reaction: 7-aminomethyl-7-carbaguanosine(34) in tRNA + S-adenosyl-L-methionine = epoxyqueuosine(34) in tRNA + adenine + L-methionine + 2 H(+); EC 2.4.99.17.

entities.name: Queuosine biosynthesis
observations: QueA is annotated in tRNA modification and tRNA-queuosine biosynthesis; the immediate product is epoxyqueuosine-modified tRNA.
